lane: EXT-D-0083 independent system disk guard review

evidence: scripts/stabilization-resource.mjs samples the checkout, profile, actual /var/tmp lease root, and / on every preflight and watchdog sample; reasons() applies the unchanged minimumFreeDiskGiB=20 policy to all four.
scripts/stabilization-resource-safety.mjs rejects invalid statfs values and turns marker-write failures into RESOURCE_SAFETY_STATE_WRITE_FAILED without reflecting marker contents.

persistSafetyState marks the run invalid and safetyStateBroken before throwing. The finalizer retains the permit when safety state failed, even if owned process cleanup succeeds; if cleanup cannot prove the workload gone, it also retains ownership. The final journal decision uses resourceInvalid and exit code 3.
The actual D54 journal ended invalid after ENOSPC despite healthy external-volume samples; this historical run does not prove the new guard at runtime.
A_outcome.limit: Source-only review. The system disk remains below the 20 GiB floor, so no guard, browser, test, build, or release was run locally. Hosted CI and a guarded runtime observation remain pending.

strengths: The new test gives distinct high external and low system readings, checks all sampled paths, and checks the 20 GiB boundary and independently low lease volume.
It checks a real 0600 marker write and an injected ENOSPC failure without payload reflection; CI invokes this focused test on a healthy host. Copied-guard fixtures include the new import.
B_quality.gap: No test injects a failed hold or stop-marker write through the actual guard while a workload is alive, then asserts invalid RESOURCE_FINAL_DECISION and retained heavy lease. The focused writer test cannot catch a regression in persistSafetyState, main's catch/finally, or release ordering. Adding the import to copied-guard fixtures keeps them loadable but does not exercise this failure path.
B_quality.recommendation: On a healthy host, add a copied-guard process fixture that injects ENOSPC at the marker write boundary and proves the real guard's exit, journal verdict, and lease ownership while owned work exists; first observe the focused CI test result.
